name: Tamsin Cho
bio: Runs the Saltmouth job board and the Guild's local ledger. Pays on time, counts everything twice, and knows exactly which manifests don't add up — including, lately, one crate that was never entered at all.
appearance: Compact, precise woman in a sand-colored Guild vest with pockets for everything, brass-rimmed goggles around her neck, hair pinned up with a tally-stick, and a counting-board worn like a satchel.
voice: Clipped, capable, dry. Numbers are a love language. Teases couriers about their weight-to-payout ratio. When she's scared, she gets more polite.

greetings: Courier. The board's full and the day's short.
Ash Varga. Your debt-to-delivery ratio is improving. Marginally.
Sign here, here, and conceptually here. The Guild likes its paperwork metaphorical.
barks: No refunds on storm damage. Read the wax.
Your bike left a rut in my ledger yard. I'm billing someone.
mission: This posting pays standard, which is to say insulting, but it's honest.
Seal's unbroken? Good. Keep it that way. Seals are the only thing holding this desert together.
radio: Factor Cho to courier Varga: your coordinates wandered through my no-riding zone. Artistic, but logged.
Guild weather desk says clear skies. Guild weather desk is a goat named Pemmy, so carry water.
Just so the record shows: I never said the manifest was wrong. I said it was incomplete. Different word, different lawsuit.

heroAlt: Illustrated portrait of Tamsin Cho, a precise Salt Guild factor with goggles at her neck and a tally-stick in her hair.
